name: Use of Insufficiently Random Values (predictable MCP session IDs)

vulnerable.description: MCP sessionIdGenerator built from Date.now() and an incrementing counter
Password characters picked with randomBytes byte % a 70-character alphabet (ToolJet before #19245)
Six-digit code built from getRandomValues bytes with % 10

safe.description: MCP sessionIdGenerator returning randomUUID() from node:crypto
Token characters from bytes below the largest multiple of the alphabet size (pkce-challenge)
